label: Business Bank Statements
description: Recent statements used to verify deposits, cash flow, account activity, NSFs, negative days, and existing advance payments.
internal_notes: Review consistency, deposit sources, NSFs, negative days, and current advance payments.

label: Funding Application
description: Standard borrower application collecting entity, owner, funding request, and use-of-funds information.
internal_notes: Should feed CRM, routing engine, and submission packet.

label: Government-Issued ID
description: Owner identification used for identity verification and funding packet completion.
internal_notes: Driver license often requested for fast-capital programs.

label: Voided Business Check
description: Bank verification item commonly requested for funding or ACH setup.
internal_notes: Confirm account ownership and business name consistency.

label: Credit Authorization
description: Authorization to review borrower credit where the product depends on personal or business credit.
internal_notes: Avoid hard-pull confusion; clarify process with borrower.

label: Credit Report
description: Credit profile used to evaluate credit-dependent funding paths and identify derogatories, inquiries, utilization, and score range.
internal_notes: Critical for 680+ startup/strong-credit paths and 600–660 fair-credit paths.

label: Income Verification
description: Paystubs, W-2, bank deposits, or other income support used when personal credit/income drives approval.
internal_notes: Important when business revenue is low or not yet established.

label: Tax Returns
description: Business or personal tax returns used for more document-heavy, bank-adjacent, SBA, growth, or real estate paths.
internal_notes: Tax issues can create routing problems; surface early.

label: Financial Statements
description: Profit and loss, balance sheet, or other financial reports used for structured underwriting and larger requests.
internal_notes: Sloppy books create underwriting drag; use for stronger files.

label: Equipment Invoice or Quote
description: Invoice, quote, or purchase order for trucks, machinery, vehicles, or business-use equipment.
internal_notes: Need asset description, seller/vendor, cost, condition, and business use.

label: Equipment Spec Sheet
description: Asset specification details supporting equipment, truck, fleet, or machinery financing.
internal_notes: Useful for avoiding obsolete/salvage-title surprises.

label: Purchase Contract
description: Real estate purchase contract or agreement used for acquisition, bridge, rental, or commercial property financing.
internal_notes: Tie request to property economics and closing timeline.

label: Appraisal / Valuation Support
description: Property valuation support used to evaluate LTV and collateral strength.
internal_notes: Watch appraisal gaps and unsupported ARV claims.

label: Rent Roll
description: Rental income schedule used for DSCR, multifamily, commercial, and income-property review.
internal_notes: Validate occupancy, lease terms, and income support.

label: Lease Agreement
description: Tenant or property lease documentation supporting real estate income or business location context.
internal_notes: Helpful for rental, commercial, and operating-location review.

label: Scope of Work
description: Project scope, budget, and timeline for fix-and-flip, renovation, bridge, or construction-related deals.
internal_notes: Scope risk is a major issue in bridge/fix-and-flip paths.

label: Marketplace / API Connection
description: Platform connection or sales data authorization for Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, or other marketplace funding paths.
internal_notes: Suspension, disconnection, or poor account health can kill the file.

label: Seller Statements / Platform Sales History
description: Marketplace sales history used to evaluate seller revenue, consistency, and growth needs.
internal_notes: Match platform revenue to bank deposits where possible.

label: Retirement Account Statement
description: Retirement asset statement used for ROBS or retirement-backed startup funding paths.
internal_notes: Use only for eligible structures; do not imply approval or tax advice.

label: Business Formation Documents
description: Entity formation, EIN, operating agreement, or registration documents used for entity validation and fundability prep.
internal_notes: Useful for business credit and bank-account consistency checks.
